semantic_contract.economic_sequence: frozen corrected collapse-gap-zone pattern -> first return to lowest meaningful unresolved layer -> rejection or acceptance process -> entry after observable confirmation -> primary-layer traversal -> success, failure, or time-stop exit
semantic_contract.causal_background: structural traversal is broad but immediate first acceptance is commonly rejected, so a compact translation family tests deeper acceptance and second reclaim without altering pattern semantics
semantic_contract.confirmation_trigger: one of four preregistered completed-minute entry confirmations
semantic_contract.entry_time: first subsequent legal one-minute open strictly after selected confirmation
semantic_contract.outcome: chronological K20 sleeve NAV after target, failure, or time-stop exits and 20 bp per-side costs

entries.E1_FIRST_ACCEPT: first completed minute close >= L after V3 first return
entries.E2_QUARTER_ACCEPT: first completed minute close >= L+0.25W after V3 first return
entries.E3_HALF_ACCEPT: first completed minute close >= L+0.50W after V3 first return
entries.E4_SECOND_RECLAIM: after first completed minute close < L following V3 first return, first later completed minute close >= L
entries.fill: next legal minute open strictly after confirmation
entries.legal_buy: same frozen PIT/action lineage, hard/current/history valid, trade_status=1, current-day tradable, market-rule valid, no blocking action, positive finite open strictly below registered upper limit

targets.target_specific_nonentry: if legal entry price is already at or above the selected target, do not enter that target configuration because traversal completed before fill
targets.fill_after_t1: on a sellable day, first legal minute open at or above target fills at that open; otherwise first later minute high reaching target fills exactly at target

t1.same_day_target_hit: record diagnostic only and do not latch success; from T+1 onward target must be executable again
t1.sellable_from: first trading session strictly after entry session

failures.F1_DAILY_LOSS_OF_ZONE: completed daily close < L; exit at first subsequent legal sell minute/open

time_stops.clock: entry session counts as session one, so stop session cal_idx=entry_cal_idx+N-1
time_stops.exit: sell at stop-session close when legally executable; if blocked or absent, first later legal sell minute/open
time_stops.same_day_priority: on T+1 or later target execution has priority intraday; time-stop close has priority over a failure signal formed at that same close

action_handling.coordinate_rule: L/U comparisons use the V3 coordinate factor; supported cash-only action resets preserve invalid_step_cum and coordinate continuity
action_handling.accepted_contract: the already accepted ASHARE-CA-REPLAY-003 minimum QD-010 contract is binding
action_handling.risk_events: source-complete share distributions with share_multiplier>1 and every explicitly registered rights issue
action_handling.known_position_rule: at the first completed market-session close with known_at<=close and close date<effective_date, force a later legal open exit strictly before effective_date
action_handling.known_new_risk_rule: block an entry when a risk event was known by its confirmation decision and the proposed entry is on or before effective_date
action_handling.cash_only_actions: source-complete share_multiplier=1 cash_per_share_gross is credited exactly on effective_date for positions entered before that date
action_handling.fail_closed: unknown timing, no pre-effective legal exit, unresolved effective row, rights participation, or unsupported action semantics block the replay
action_handling.pit_grade: bounded PIT-B current-history research; no strict PIT-A claim

execution_correction_audit.reason: the first implementation invented action-lineage stopping instead of recovering the repository-authoritative accepted QD-010 risk-exit and exact-cash contract

portfolio.allocation_nav_mark: cash plus active positions at latest completed daily close; approximately one twentieth

period_boundary.signals: entry timestamp must fall inside period
period_boundary.period_end: positions still open at period end are marked to the final valid close but are not counted as completed trades
period_boundary.stitched_walk_forward: multiply independent cash-start test-year sleeve returns; no old-rule position carry across January selection boundaries

training_gate.no_eligible_action: SELECTION_BLOCKED and test sleeve remains cash

tie_breaks: entry simplicity E1 then E2 then E3 then E4

parameter_stability_classification.STABLE: at most two distinct full configurations across five folds and the modal full configuration is selected in at least three folds
parameter_stability_classification.MODERATELY_ADAPTIVE: three distinct full configurations across five folds
parameter_stability_classification.HIGHLY_UNSTABLE: four or five distinct full configurations across five folds

deterministic_order: IMPLEMENTATION_BLOCKED if a selected replay violates required lineage or correctness invariants
NO_ZONE_STRATEGY_EDGE if fixed 50/50 stitched total return is non-positive

MARGINAL_ZONE_STRATEGY_EDGE if the fixed 50/50 result does not exceed the simple average of the two continuous-board baseline total returns, has non-positive Calmar, or fewer than half of unblocked top-five neighborhood tests are profitable
ZONE_STRATEGY_EDGE_BUT_CONCENTRATED if otherwise qualifying positive edge turns non-positive after excluding 2020 or the best five PnL days in either positive-return sleeve
ZONE_STRATEGY_EDGE_BUT_ENTRY_UNSTABLE if otherwise qualifying entry-family sequence is HIGHLY_UNSTABLE on either board
verdict_policy.ready_evidence: positive stitched walk-forward economics, improvement over fixed E1 baseline, positive Calmar, at least half-profitable top-five neighborhood support, no 2020 or best-five-day domination, and entry-family stability; no requirement that all five years be positive

diagnostics: top five TRAIN configurations replayed unchanged next year
entry, target, failure, and time-stop selection frequency
return excluding 2020 and best one/five days
forbidden: panic, Dryup, Compression, RSI, MACD, RS, ML, ST exclusion, or new industry filters
